feed.title: Ríad M. Nassiffe - Python
feed.subtitle: Greetings! My name is Ríad Mattos Nassiffe, and I am currently a professor at [IFC-campus Blumenau](https://blumenau.ifc.edu.br/). I teach computer science in the technical computing and bachelor’s degree programs in Computer Science. My courses cover programming, operating systems, data structures, embedded systems, and computer architecture and organization.
